550:t_1:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Thank you for looking after the place, $$カリーニン$$.」

550:t_1:7.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「No... It's nothing. I'm glad you're safe.」

550:t_1:9.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(Though she is only a girl of 17, she carries herself like a ruler of the world... Is she really that same $$千鳥かなめ$$...?)

550:t_1:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「You seem to have sensed her transformation.」

550:t_1:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「Your former subordinate, $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$, is dead.」

550:t_1:13.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...Though we lost $$カスパー$$ too, losing $$ウェーバー$$ must hurt them badly. He can be more troublesome than $$相良$$ at times.」

550:t_1:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You don't need to worry anymore, $$カリーニン$$. I killed $$宗介$$ and $$テッサ$$.」

550:t_1:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's all right, $$ミスタ・Ｋ$$.」

550:t_1:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This is where it begins, isn't it, $$レナード$$?」

550:t_1:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「Yes... Construction of the temple for you... and to save us... is already complete.」

550:t_1:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「The enemies who realized our intentions will come too... If we meet them here on $$メリダ島$$, everything will be over.」

550:t_1:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$メリダ島$$... I never thought... I'd come here... like this...」

550:t_1:24.en:
$$レナード$$
(So some of $$千鳥かなめ$$'s feelings still remain...)

550:t_1:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Let's go, $$レナード$$. I can't wait to see the biggest and greatest $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$.」

550:t_1:26.en:
$$レナード$$
「I understand. ...$$ミスタ・Ｋ$$, I'm leaving the rest to you.」

550:t_1:28.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(I heard what happened at $$ヤムスク１１$$ in the reports, but seeing it myself is still startling...)

550:t_1:29.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(Has that pure, honest girl been lost forever...?)

550:t_1:30.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(But perhaps that was her fate...)

550:t_1:31.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(...Why am I hesitating now...? I believed $$レナード$$ when he said he would put this world right.)

550:t_1:32.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(I've always felt that unease... This world has been distorted...)

550:t_1:33.en:
$$カリーニン$$
($$イリーナ$$... A world where I lost you is the wrong history...)

550:t_1:34.en:
$$カリーニン$$
(If it means starting everything over, I no longer have any doubts or hesitation...)

550:t_1:38.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Captain's Cabin～

550:t_1:39.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Please report on each unit's status.」

550:t_1:40.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We have received Chief of Staff $$城田$$'s report on the detachment sent to Japan.」

550:t_1:41.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「According to it, they discovered that the mysterious robot army belongs to the $$ガイゾック$$ from $$ＵＣＷ$$...」

550:t_1:42.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「They also confirmed the revival of $$皇帝ズール$$, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, and $$ハーデス$$ of $$ミケーネ$$.」

550:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
(At this moment... The situation really is beginning to change rapidly...)

550:t_1:44.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Also, the $$トライダー$$, $$ダイ・ガード$$, $$ダイターン３$$, $$ゴッドマーズ$$, $$鉄人２８号#robot$$, $$マジンガーＺ$$, $$真ゲッターロボ$$, and $$ダンクーガノヴァマックスゴッド$$...」

550:t_1:45.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Each has grown stronger, and the $$くろがね五人衆$$ and Prince $$グーラ$$ have offered their assistance.」

550:t_1:46.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「They report new combination attacks for $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$ and $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, $$真ゲッター１$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, and the three Invincible Robots.」

550:t_1:47.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「However, fighting in another dimension and other battles badly damaged their machines. They cannot currently carry out operations.」

550:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「How are the units operating in space doing?」

550:t_1:49.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「They secured the cooperation of $$ハマーン・カーン$$'s group and $$ギュネイ・ガス$$, who defected from $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

550:t_1:50.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「They also successfully separated $$ザフト$$ from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, effectively cutting their fighting strength in half.」

550:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That should prevent $$ネオ・ジオン$$ from interfering with our battle against the Empire.」

550:t_1:52.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「They confirmed Ensign $$リディ$$ is alive. He pilots a black $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ called $$バンシィ$$ and commands a $$クロノ$$ Conservative field unit.」

550:t_1:53.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$クロノ$$ used Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$ as a hostage to demand our surrender, but our forces secured her safety.」

550:t_1:54.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「There are also reports that the Gundams were upgraded or gained access to their capabilities during the fighting.」

550:t_1:56.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Unfortunately, they are stationed aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$. With repairs to their machines as well, they cannot come to Earth immediately.」

550:t_1:57.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Send each detachment a report on our situation. Since they cannot arrive in time, we will go to $$メリダ島$$ on our own.」

550:t_1:59.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Don't worry, $$マデューカス$$. Given the battlefield, we will need breakthrough capability more than a large force.」

550:t_1:60.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We will hold a briefing in six hours. Please gather everyone in the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s hangar.」

550:t_1:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$レナード$$... I cannot surrender this world to your ego...)

550:t_1:63.en:
$$テッサ$$
(We will stake our lives on preventing that.)
